cohort: The cohort consists of pregnant women recruited from their first trimester and their twin offspring from birth, encompassing 13,869 twin pairs from population-based samples and an additional 1,000 twin pairs and their mothers from a hospital-based sample.
finding: This article describes the design, recruitment, follow-up, and data collection of the Wuhan Twin Birth Cohort (WTBC), which aims to expand the understanding of genetic and environmental influences on pregnancy and twin development in China.
followup_time: 18 years (for twins), from first trimester of pregnancy (for mothers)
